lines.text: Jesus says nations will be bewildered by the roaring of the sea, and men will faint from fear.
They will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud, and Jesus tells them to stand up because their redemption is near.
Jesus tells a parable of the fig tree: when it sprouts leaves, you know that winter is near.
Jesus warns that the worries of life can weigh hearts down, and that the day will come like a snare, so they should keep watch and pray.
Every day Jesus taught at the temple, and every evening He went out to spend the night in Capernaum.
